name: mq_timedsend
synopsis: int mq_send(mqd_t mqdes, const char *msg_ptr, size_t msg_len, unsigned int msg_prio);
int mq_timedsend(mqd_t mqdes, const char *msg_ptr, size_t msg_len, unsigned int msg_prio, const struct timespec *abs_timeout);
description: mq_timedsend() adds a message to a message queue with a specified absolute timeout. If the queue is full and O_NONBLOCK is not set, it waits until space is available or the timeout expires. It operates similarly to mq_send() but includes timeout functionality.

parameters.name: msg_len
parameters.description: Length of the message in bytes.

parameters.name: msg_prio
parameters.description: Priority of the message, with higher values indicating higher priority.

parameters.name: abs_timeout
parameters.description: Pointer to a timespec structure specifying the absolute timeout.

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error

errors.description: The queue was full, and the O_NONBLOCK flag was set.
The descriptor specified in mqdes was invalid or not opened for writing.
The call was interrupted by a signal handler.
The call would have blocked, and abs_timeout was invalid.
msg_len was greater than the mq_msgsize attribute of the message queue.
The call timed out before a message could be transferred.

versions: On Linux, mq_timedsend() is a system call.
